name: Commerce Vipps MobilePay Express
description: Express checkout with Vipps MobilePay, skipping Drupal's checkout.
project_description:
This module allows to quickly checkout with Vipps MobilePay Checkout skipping Drupal's own checkout.

 Features 
 This module provides payment gateway plugin for Vipps MobilePay API products which extends Vipps MobilePay Checkout plugin:

- CheckoutExpress

 Post-Installation 
 Once the module is downloaded (with Composer) and enabled you can start using it by creating a respective payment gateway.

 Additional Requirements 
 This project needs to be downloaded with Composer. It requires Vipps MobilePay Commerce module.
